data.one_liner: Provides Reactive Forms compatible widgets for picking images and videos.
data.what_it_does: Wraps the image_picker package to expose its functionality as Reactive Form controls. Supports single and multiple image/video selection with optional preview builders.
use_when: You need image or video picking integrated with reactive_forms
You want a ready‑made form field widget for media selection
avoid_when: You need advanced image editing or cropping features
strengths: Supports both images and videos across mobile and web
Provides callbacks for cleanup and custom preview UI
weaknesses: Limited to the features of image_picker
No built‑in image editing or cropping
data.setup_notes: Add the package, ensure image_picker permissions are configured for Android/iOS, no build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Direct use without Reactive Forms integration, fewer abstractions
